title: SPLIT SECOND
summary: Action and consequence — withheld release, phase alignment, and impact. Create a sequence around release using six bounded excerpts. Twice cut away immediately before a hand lets go. On the third return, allow the object's actual consequence to arrive. Align later actions by phase, let one hesitation resist, and end on an ordinary release. Cut across 7 verified public-domain archival windows (34.5s) and audited across two Critic Tribunal rounds (v1 → v2).

reviews.text:
VERDICT: repair_required (Round 1 — v1 assembly audit)
Critic Role: Independent continuity critic

Observed Defects on v1 Proof Strip:
- Seg #05 (t=14.00s-19.50s): `874e1f7f` contains internal cuts across dark industrial slats with no drop into liquid or splash.
- Seg #07 (t=23.30s-29.80s): `61aca239` cuts internally from factory bottles to a clenched fist.

Largest Gap:
Seg #05 shows dark industrial slats with internal cuts instead of a drop into liquid, and Seg #07 cuts mid-shot instead of holding an object without letting go.

Causal Hypothesis:
OpenCLIP mismatch on `874e1f7f` and unverified scene cut inside `61aca239`.

Falsifiable Repair Condition:
Replace Seg #05 with verified cut-free liquid drop/stream impact `5a786b16` (`0.2s-5.7s`, 8.1s clean window) and replace Seg #07 with human-verified cut-free shot of hands holding family photographs without letting go (`b066405d`, `0.1s-6.0s`, 6.1s clean window).

Strength to Preserve:
The three-part withheld-release grammar across Seg #02, #03, and #04 (`0870ef3a` and `9e7292f1`), where the third return completes the release of the 'SORROW' block, and the ordinary fabric release at the close (`3e4b0f51`).
